title: Wonderful Grace of Jesus
lyrics_original: How shall my tongue describe it,
For the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.
Mighty rolling sea                The rolling sea
For even me                             For even me
Broader than the scope of my transgressions
Greater far than all my sin and shame;
O magnify the precious Name of Jesus.
By it I have been pardoned,
For the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.
Mighty rolling sea                The rolling sea
For even me                             For even me
Broader than the scope of my transgressions
Greater far than all my sin and shame;
O magnify the precious Name of Jesus.
And the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.
Mighty rolling sea                The rolling sea
For even me                             For even me
Broader than the scope of my transgressions
Greater far than all my sin and shame;
O magnify the precious Name of Jesus.

bible_verses.english: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast.
but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly; that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your matchless grace that reaches down to me. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my own burdens instead of giving them to You. Thank You for lifting my shame and setting my spirit free. Help me to walk in the joy of Your salvation today and share Your wonderful grace with others. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your matchless grace that reaches down to me. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my own burdens instead of giving them to You. devotional.reflection_english: No matter how heavy our burdens or how deep our missteps, the grace of Jesus is always greater. When we try to describe His love, words often fall short, yet our hearts cannot help but sing. Christ invites us to lay down the weight of our sin and step into the true freedom He freely offers. Today, take a breath and rest in the matchless grace that has already reached you right where you are.
